newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-EARLY IKPEBA GOAL SENDS MONACO INTO SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EARLY IKPEBA GOAL SENDS MONACO INTO SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Nigerian winger Victor Ikpeba scored in the second minute to give Monaco a 1-0 win at Lens in the French League Cup quarter-finals on Wednesday.
In the first division leaders' first attack, defender Gilles Grimandi raced down the right wing and Ikpeba turned his low cross into the net with a first-time volley.
Bordeaux joined Monaco in the semifinal draw when they overcame stern resistance from Caen to beat them 4-2 in a penalty shootout following a 0-0 draw after extra time.
Striker Jean-Pierre Papin found the net in the first half of extra time but the goal was disallowed for handball by Bordeaux's former France international.
Strasbourg and Montpellier both won on Tuesday to make it an all-first division semifinal line-up.
Striker David Zitelli, second highest scorer in the first division, hit a hat-trick as Strasbourg came from behind to beat second division Louhans-Cuiseaux 5-1 with four goals in extra time.
